item.text:
**Assessment**
Modi’s 2024 record shows a clear governing program on the policy side: jobs, infrastructure, manufacturing, rural incomes, welfare targeting, fiscal discipline, and digital administration. It also shows a revealed power-maintenance track: communal mobilization, information control, opaque political finance, and coalition bargaining. So 8B.1 is clearly met, but the content is mixed and often opportunistic.

**Claim-Level Evidence**
- [India’s Modi promises to create jobs, boost infrastructure if BJP wins third term](https://theprint.in/india/indias-modi-promises-to-create-jobs-boost-infrastructure-if-bjp-wins-third-term/2040266/)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint  
  **Date:** 2024-04-14  
  **Claim:** Modi’s manifesto-style pitch tied the government’s direction to jobs, infrastructure, semiconductors, green energy, aviation, railways, and expanded health coverage. This is the clearest explicit governing program in 2024.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.1

- [India eyes $100 billion annual foreign direct investment in coming years: IT minister](https://theprint.in/india/india-eyes-100-billion-annual-foreign-direct-investment-in-coming-years-it-minister/1928045/)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint  
  **Date:** 2024-01-17  
  **Claim:** The government publicly framed 2024 around attracting large-scale FDI through infrastructure, manufacturing, and easier business processes. This gives a strategic growth direction that can be evaluated later.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.1

- [India’s finance minister unveils budget with focus on poor, women, youth and farmers](https://theprint.in/india/indias-finance-minister-unveils-budget-with-focus-on-poor-women-youth-and-farmers/1948406/)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint  
  **Date:** 2024-02-01  
  **Claim:** The interim budget explicitly centered disadvantaged groups and avoided a classic pre-poll giveaway. That is a concrete policy program, not just broad rhetoric.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.1

- [Exclusive: India’s Modi chasing reform legacy shifts income goals for struggling farmers](https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/indias-modi-chasing-reform-legacy-shifts-income-goals-for-struggling-farmers)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via The Straits Times  
  **Date:** 2024-05-08  
  **Claim:** Modi’s administration set targets to lift rural incomes, expand non-farm jobs, and increase agricultural investment. This is an explicit strategic direction aimed at livelihood transformation.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.1

- [India budget shifts spending priorities while keeping fiscal deficit in check](https://theprint.in/india/india-budget-shifts-spending-priorities-while-keeping-fiscal-deficit-in-check/2187377/)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint  
  **Date:** 2024-07-23  
  **Claim:** The post-election budget cut the deficit target while raising capital and investment-linked spending. This is strong evidence of a governable economic program rather than ad hoc spending alone.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.1

- [AI-assisted grievance redress, last-mile service delivery approved](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=1997326&lang=2&reg=48)  
  **Publisher:** Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions  
  **Date:** 2024-01-18  
  **Claim:** The government approved AI-assisted grievance redress, service delivery, and process re-engineering. This shows an administrative-modernization program that can be evaluated against later service outcomes.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.1

- [Government appoints members for new Finance Commission](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/indian-government-appoints-members-for-new-finance-panel-3287402)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via Investing.com  
  **Date:** 2024-01-30  
  **Claim:** The Finance Commission was staffed with experienced officials and economists, indicating a technocratic economic direction rather than pure personal rule.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.1

- [India’s president invites Modi to head new coalition government, swearing-in on Sunday](https://theprint.in/india/indias-president-invites-modi-to-head-new-coalition-government-swearing-in-on-sunday/2121711/)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint  
  **Date:** 2024-06-07  
  **Claim:** After losing the solo majority, Modi accepted the president’s invitation and framed the new NDA arrangement as a coalition government. This is a revealed power strategy: retain office through constitutional coalition management.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.1, 7B.10

- [India’s Modi sworn in as prime minister for historic third term](https://theprint.in/india/indias-modi-sworn-in-as-prime-minister-for-historic-third-term/2123770/)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint  
  **Date:** 2024-06-09  
  **Claim:** Modi’s oath-taking after the setback was a normal constitutional transfer. It is limited evidence of a stable power strategy that accepts institutional procedure.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.1, 7B.10

- [Explainer: what were India’s electoral bonds and how did they power Modi’s party](https://theprint.in/india/explainer-what-were-indias-electoral-bonds-and-how-did-they-power-modis-party/1969006/)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint  
  **Date:** 2024-02-16  
  **Claim:** The electoral-bonds system allowed unlimited anonymous donations, and the BJP was the largest beneficiary. This is strong revealed-evidence of a political-finance model that advantaged the ruling party and obscured funding.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.1, 7B.10

- [India top court puts on hold unit for fact-checking online content about govt](https://theprint.in/india/india-top-court-puts-on-hold-unit-for-fact-checking-online-content-about-govt/2009612/)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint  
  **Date:** 2024-03-21  
  **Claim:** The government created a fact-checking unit with power to flag content about government business as false or misleading, and the Supreme Court stayed it. This is direct evidence of an information-control strategy aimed at protecting the regime’s narrative.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.1, 7B.10

- [India’s Modi calls rivals pro-Muslim as election campaign changes tack](https://theprint.in/india/indias-modi-calls-rivals-pro-muslim-as-election-campaign-changes-tack/2053223/)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint  
  **Date:** 2024-04-23  
  **Claim:** Modi pivoted from development messaging toward anti-Muslim attacks and wealth-redistribution warnings. That is revealed strategy through polarization, not just policy articulation.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.1, 2B.6, 7B.10

- [India’s poll panel orders Modi’s BJP, opposition Congress to show restraint in campaign](https://theprint.in/india/indias-poll-panel-orders-modis-bjp-opposition-congress-to-show-restraint-in-campaign/2096809/)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint  
  **Date:** 2024-05-22  
  **Claim:** The Election Commission said the parties’ defenses were “not tenable” and ordered restraint after complaints about divisive speeches, including Modi’s communal remarks. This shows the campaign’s strategic direction included norm-bending power politics.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.1, 2B.6, 7B.10

- [Indian opposition calls for Adani probe; Modi’s BJP questions timing of U.S. indictment](https://theprint.in/india/indian-opposition-calls-for-adani-probe-modis-bjp-questions-timing-of-us-indictment/2367046/)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint  
  **Date:** 2024-11-21  
  **Claim:** After Adani’s U.S. indictment, opposition parties accused Modi’s government of shielding a politically connected conglomerate. The article does not prove direct personal benefit, but it strengthens the conflict-of-interest and protection-network reading.  
  **Question IDs:** 8B.1, 7B.10

**Search Gap**
I did not find a single 2024 source where Modi lays out a full abstract ideology document in one place. The strongest evidence is instead assembled from repeated programmatic statements, budgets, appointments, and revealed power-maintenance behavior.

**Net Read**
Yes, 8B.1 is present. Modi’s 2024 governing style is legible as a developmental-nationalist program with technocratic instruments, but it is also paired with a clear regime-maintenance layer built on polarization, messaging control, and finance/patronage advantages.
